label: One and the same candidate is concrete, actually exists, exists in every accessible world, and has…
paraphrase: One and the same candidate is concrete, actually exists, exists in every accessible world, and has no incoming selected grounding arrow from an existing concrete candidate at any admitted world. Non-concrete support or explanation is not excluded. No uniqueness, self-explanation, simplicity, intellect or God identification is asserted.
